Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: CRED's gift card purchase sheet - a brand gift card with preset amount pills and a custom numpad input where the typed amount renders on the card and scales its digits to fit, while the payable price updates live below.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark CRED app. Entry: brand picker grid (Jockey, Uber, Amazon, Zepto, PVR logos). Detail sheet: a metallic dark Uber gift card near the top showing brand name and the current amount in large numerals. Under it: a row of preset amount pills (one selected, dark fill), a "custom amount" field, a note row, the payable line ("you pay Rs 2,865" with an effective-price tag), and a black Buy Now button. Tapping custom amount raises a numeric keypad over the bottom half.

## Motion spec
Pattern: carousel picker with inline number input and fit-to-card text scaling.
- Sheet entrance: card and controls slide up (300ms ease-out), card settling with a small spring (~280/22).
- Preset pill tap: pill fills dark (120ms), the card's amount crossfades to the new value (150ms), and the payable price updates with a 150ms crossfade.
- Custom input: keypad slides up (280ms ease-out); each digit tap appends to the card amount immediately, with a blinking caret.
- Amount typography: the numeral string scales to stay on one line inside the card - "Rs 3,000" at full size, "Rs 10,000" stepping down a size, long values shrinking smoothly (interpolate font size, no snapping); deleting digits scales back up.
- Payable price recalculates per keystroke with a subtle count-tween (100ms) between values.
- Keypad dismiss: slides down (250ms), sheet returns to rest.

## Calibration
- The text-inside-card scaling is the star - digits must shrink and grow fluidly per keystroke, never overflow or wrap.
- The card keeps its metallic sheen static; only the amount text changes.

## Reduced motion
Sheet and keypad fade in/out over 150ms without travel; amount and price swap instantly per keystroke.

## Don't miss
- The caret trails the amount on the card itself during custom entry, not in a separate field.
- The payable line shows both the discounted figure and the savings tag, and both update per keystroke.
